create_task_entities_initializer: create a TaskEntitiesInitializer that runs multiple initializers sequentially until one fails
create_pose_initializer: create a PoseInitializer to set entity position and quaternion using a pose sampler
create_joints_initializer: create a JointsInitializer to set robot arm joint angles using a joints sampler
create_callable_initializer: create a CallableInitializer that wraps a single callable function as an initializer
use_no_init: use the NO_INIT constant as a no-op TaskEntitiesInitializer with an empty initializer list
